title: 第11章 吃火锅圣主造了两千斤肉第12章 火灵儿的脑补杀猪刀
slug: 厨神把师姐们喂成女帝
content_zh:
瑶池圣主现在闲的无聊就会观察林东方在做什么好饭好菜。
她已经走到了修炼的一个极点，短时间是无法有所突破的，每天都无所事事。
现在她很喜欢观察林东方烹饪菜肴，这让她心里有种很安稳的感觉。
她立刻回到水晶仙宫，端坐在宝座上。
不多时，程大发和李金炎过来求取仙泉。
“既然如此，那我也一起去看看吧。”
瑶池圣主准备出早已备好的仙泉水，直接撕开空间降临在林东方小院外。
她是一秒都等不及了。
那股和麻辣味道纠缠在一起的道韵像是勾魂的锁链一样！
程大发和李金炎相视苦笑。
原来这圣主大人早就忍不住了啊。
圣主肯定不能和他们几个人一个桌子吃饭，她坐在另一边，自备了锅具之类的。
周身外闪烁着朦胧光华，虽然近在眼前，但是所有人都看不清她的身影，仿佛隔绝了一道星宇。
程小云被安排到了另外一边，她要专心对付林东方切的那二十斤牛肉。
夹起一片牛肉涮烫片刻后，她惊讶的发现汤中的道韵居然融进了这牛肉片中一丝！
低头看看蘸料，连这里面都有一丝几乎微不可察的道韵。
这厨仙体简直就是变态啊！
程小云在心里暗暗嘀咕一句，然后开造！
薄如蝉翼的肉片，下锅抖了几下就彻底熟透，在蘸料里摆上两下塞进嘴里，鲜嫩软滑的香肉入口即化，一股暖流随后直达四肢百骸。
林东方给她准备了蒜蓉香油碟、陈醋酸辣香菜葱花油碟，还有芝麻酱碟。

不同口味的蘸料让牛肉片爆发出不一样的香味。
随之爆发的还有那天地大道！
程小云想哭！
自己还修炼个什么劲啊。
估计以后进了元婴境辛辛苦苦打坐一年感悟的道韵说不定都没这一盘肉多！
“全吃完，一定要全吃完，这二十斤牛肉包含的道韵相当于一碗悟道茶！”
对于初入凝丹境界的她来说，这些道韵已经是极限了。
万兽骨鼎化作合适的大小，两个老头带着一个小伙子在大吃特吃。
“不愧是仙泉啊！”
林东方涮了一片肉之后，发现这肉中蕴含了一股特殊的力量。
吃下之后，通体舒泰，忙活一天的疲惫一扫而空！
不由得让他惊叹连连。
其实服用仙泉水好处是巨大的，他现在还感应不出来而已。
“还有这肉，比青金牦牛的肉质还好！”
“嘿嘿，这可是一尊通天境大妖的肉，里面的力量被我的骨鼎炼化了，两百年来我小心翼翼的吃，除去送给圣主的两千斤，这是最后两千斤了！”
程大发的话让林东方倒吸冷气。
好家伙，渡劫境大佬吃肉都是用千斤做单位么？
太可怕了。
他对于渡劫境的实力还没有概念。
千言万语，只化成了两个字。

牛逼！
content_en:
When the Holy Lord of Yaochi is bored now, he will observe what good food Lin Dongfang is making.
She has reached the extreme point of her cultivation and cannot make a breakthrough in a short time. She has nothing to do every day.
Now she likes to observe Lin Dongfang cooking dishes, which gives her a very stable feeling in her heart.
She immediately returned to the Crystal Palace and sat on the throne.
Not long after, Cheng Dafa and Li Jinyan came over to ask for the fairy spring.
"In that case, let me go and have a look too."
The Holy Master of Yaochi prepared the fairy spring water that had been prepared, and directly tore open the space and landed outside Lin Dongfang's small courtyard.
She couldn't wait a second.
The Tao rhyme entwined with the spicy taste is like a chain that seduces the soul!
Cheng Dafa and Li Jinyan looked at each other and smiled bitterly.
It turns out that the Holy Lord couldn't bear it anymore.
The Holy Master definitely couldn't eat at the same table as the rest of them. She sat on the other side and brought her own pots and pans.
There was a hazy brilliance flashing outside her body. Although she was close in front of them, no one could see her figure clearly, as if she was cut off by a starry sky.
Cheng Xiaoyun was assigned to the other side, and she had to concentrate on dealing with the twenty kilograms of beef that Lin Dongfang had cut.
After picking up a piece of beef and scalding it for a while, she was surprised to find that the Taoist flavor in the soup was actually blended into the beef slice!
Looking down at the dipping sauce, there is an almost imperceptible trace of Taoism in it.
This chef's body is simply abnormal!
Cheng Xiaoyun muttered secretly in his heart, and then started building!
The slices of meat are as thin as cicada wings. After being shaken for a few times in the pot, they are completely cooked. After adding a few dips in the dipping sauce and stuffing them into your mouth, the tender, soft and fragrant meat melts in your mouth, and a warm current goes straight to the limbs.
Lin Dongfang prepared a dish for her with garlic sesame oil, vinegar, spicy and sour coriander and scallion oil, and sesame sauce.
Different flavors of dipping sauce give the beef slices a different flavor.
What followed was the outbreak of the Great Avenue of Heaven and Earth!
Cheng Xiaoyun wants to cry!
Why should I practice hard on my own?
It is estimated that Daoyun, who will enter the Nascent Soul Realm and meditate hard for a year to gain insights, may not have as much meat as this plate!
"Eat it all, be sure to eat it all. The Tao Yun contained in these twenty kilograms of beef is equivalent to a bowl of enlightenment tea!"
For her who had just entered the realm of condensation, these Taoist rhymes were already the limit.
The Ten Thousand Beast Bone Cauldron was transformed into a suitable size, and two old men and a young man were feasting on it.
"It is indeed a fairy spring!"
After Lin Dongfang rinsed a piece of meat, he found that the meat contained a special power.
After eating it, I feel so comfortable all over my body, and the fatigue from a busy day is gone!
He couldn't help but be amazed again and again.
In fact, the benefits of taking fairy spring water are huge, but he can't feel it yet.
"And this meat is better than the meat of the green gold yak!"
"Hehe, this is the meat of a Tongtian realm demon. The power inside has been refined by my bone cauldron. I have eaten it carefully for two hundred years. Apart from the two thousand kilograms given to the Holy Lord, this is the last two thousand kilograms!"
Cheng Dafa's words made Lin Dongfang gasp.
Good guy, do the big guys in the Tribulation Realm eat meat in units of kilograms?
It's terrible.
He has no idea about the strength of the Tribulation Realm.
Thousands of words turned into just two words.
Awesome!
